blocks.content:
Lokpal has its own:
• Inquiry Wing – conducts preliminary inquiries.
• Prosecution Wing – initiates prosecution in special courts.

items: Note that the Inquiry Wing handles preliminary inquiries, not final trials.
The Prosecution Wing files cases directly in Special Courts, a frequent subject of statement-based questions.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Lokpal is equipped with its own dedicated Inquiry Wing and Prosecution Wing.
The Inquiry Wing is responsible for conducting preliminary inquiries into complaints.
The Prosecution Wing initiates legal proceedings and prosecution specifically in special courts.
